title: I ported my game launcher from a desktop app to the web with the help of Claude!
author: Ok_Promotion_9578
selftext:
It's fully featured and runs pretty well! Game startup takes 20-30 seconds, so looking into ways to parallelize the startup tasks to try to get players into the game in \~10 or less. 

Game is an animal life multiplayer survival! links below. 

Play online:  
[http://savannah.hobbyhood.app/](http://savannah.hobbyhood.app/)

Landing page:  
[https://savannah-landing.hobbyhood.app/](https://savannah-landing.hobbyhood.app/)

comments.author: Prior-Meeting1645
comments.body: Wow looks impressive how do  your animals have lively changing facial expressions?

replies.author: Ok_Promotion_9578
replies.body: The animal models are made and animated in block bench! animated them with the help of an artist friend who had some neat tricks to do eyes/eyebrows/etc and he did a fantastic job with them!

comments.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
comments.body:
This looks amazing! is it playable in browser?

I love the colors 

I am currently building a game portal with hundreds of games from other indie developers and would love to include yours! We can use a link or if you have filed to upload will send you a dev portal link . The website is called SLAGDOCK, similar to MINICLIP, Newgrounds, KONGREGATE

replies.author: Ok_Promotion_9578
replies.body:
It is, but works a bit better when running native.   
You can play it on browser here:   
[http://savannah.hobbyhood.app/](http://savannah.hobbyhood.app/) and download native launcher here: [https://savannah-landing.hobbyhood.app/download](https://savannah-landing.hobbyhood.app/download)
